text: oh lol ok so my model is in, these other models tho are they suppose to be the same models or different
resolution: Answered the user's question about NPC models: they should be full distinct humanoid figures (same GAME_FIGURE system as the player, different individuals — own face/outfit per kind), not copies and not a different model type. The blocky proxies were a stopgap I introduced to dodge a slot limit; superseded — see req_0933.
